rationale: Proposal to train the relation-aware RGCN with node-type-aware hard negatives and report random-negative and hard-negative ranking side by side, motivated by the hard-negative collapse. It was implemented as hard_negative_training.py and rejected by F-0034, which measured worse ranking with hard-negative training.
subject: P-10
title: Train the RGCN on hard negatives (F-0025)
